description: Add a deadline that does not follow from the term — a rent review, an index adjustment, a payment date. Required: contract_id, title, due_on. Optional: kind, lead_days, evidence (the clause it comes from — a deadline without one is an assertion).

due_on.description: Due date of the deadline (ISO date)

evidence.description: The contract clause the deadline comes from

kind.description: Kind of deadline, e.g. review, payment, renewal, notice or other

lead_days.description: Days before due_on at which the deadline should be acted on

name: add_contract_deadline
